title: Suffolk Fire & Rescue leads with new Z-Vent ventilators for respiratory aid - NewsBreak
text: Suffolk, Va. (WAVY) – Suffolk Fire and Rescue is becoming the first emergency service agency (EMS) in southern Hampton Roads to place Zoll Z-Vent transport ventilators in all frontline Advanced Life Support ambulances and EMS supervisor vehicles. These ventilators bring hospital-quality ventilatory support directly to the field for airway management support. Z-Vent ventilators allow paramedics to deliver precise ventilation to patients requiring advanced respiratory support, both through invasive and non-invasive methods, depending on the situation. “These ventilators provide our well trained and experienced paramedics to provide critical care medicine from our ambulances.” said Suffolk Fire and Rescue Chief Mike Barakey, “I am excited that Suffolk Fire & Rescue is once again demonstrating our commitment to providing the best emergency medical care, treatment and transportation to our patients.” Suffolk Fire and Rescue personnel have completed comprehensive training with the Z-Vent systems to ensure they are used safely and effectively in a wide number of emergency situations. For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to WAVY.com.
